verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a hosting platform that stores user data (forms, blobs, managed Postgres). The pack documents no export or data-portability feature. The REST API and CLI are general management building blocks, not a documented export of all data in open formats, and a user migrating off is a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
